legacy_backlog: planning/tasks.json is unchanged; this is not executable controller authorization
policy: Original dates remain fixed. Select by dependency evidence and priority. Carry over unfinished work; mark missed targets instead of restarting Day 1. Reconcile repository evidence before execution. Never launch a worker from this file alone.

tasks.title: Revalidate and integrate the pending execution fixes
tasks.acceptance: Exact current head/base checks, recorded review and confirmed merge, or precise remaining gate.

tasks.title: Prevent missing future prices from changing past entries
tasks.acceptance: Observed before-fail/after-pass regression; censored open trade preserves the original entry.

tasks.title: Reject incomplete session opening ranges
tasks.acceptance: First/middle/last missing-range and timezone tests; full valid ranges still work.

tasks.title: Review first-week delivery and revise the alpha forecast
tasks.acceptance: Receipt with actual delivered work, unresolved dependencies and unchanged original target dates.

tasks.title: Route research to a capable executor without invoking coding
tasks.acceptance: Unavailable research capability fails clearly; DATA/FUNDAMENTAL/STRATEGY never launch the legacy coder.

tasks.title: Bind imported data metadata to the bytes actually parsed
tasks.acceptance: Known fixture bytes determine timestamps, count, gaps and checksum; mutated payload is rejected.

tasks.title: Record forecast provenance and conservative availability times
tasks.acceptance: Late forecast/revision stays unavailable before its observation time; precision bounds tested.

tasks.title: Specify account-currency P&L and risk invariants
tasks.acceptance: Hand-calculable currency, fees, quantity and overlap test vectors; unresolved ledger features identified.

tasks.title: Validate one authorized real-price sample
tasks.acceptance: Permitted source, retrieved-byte checksum, actual coverage and gap report; never substitute fixtures.

tasks.title: Replay three experts end to end on the verified sample
tasks.acceptance: Reproducible proposals, decisions, account effects and explicit execution limitations.

tasks.title: Reproduce the real-data slice and benchmark one run
tasks.acceptance: Clean-run parity and measured wall time/memory; no profitability claim.

tasks.title: Implement the canonical family registry and eligibility contract
tasks.acceptance: Fifteen stable family IDs with variant/data/exit rules; unsupported experts marked ineligible.

tasks.title: Implement and test the first missing technical family
tasks.acceptance: One fully specified family with positive, negative and causal test oracles; no placeholder completion.

tasks.title: Implement and test a contrasting technical family
tasks.acceptance: Distinct rule and required data, versioned proposal and no-signal tests; remaining families explicit.

tasks.title: Build bounded within-family comparison records
tasks.acceptance: Variant trials use matched costs and registered search limits; synthetic runs remain test-only.

tasks.title: Test purging and temporal split boundaries
tasks.acceptance: Training labels cannot overlap forbidden evaluation information; numeric boundary cases.

tasks.title: Run a small eligible development-window comparison
tasks.acceptance: Frozen configuration and complete trial register; no final holdout tuning.

tasks.title: Review cross-family redundancy and missing coverage
tasks.acceptance: Evidence of incremental differences; no forced champion and no claim all fifteen were evaluated.

tasks.title: Compare the deterministic Core with frozen baselines
tasks.acceptance: No-trade, preselected specialist and deterministic selector share account/cost assumptions.

tasks.title: Prepare a temporally out-of-sample training dataset
tasks.acceptance: Specialist predictions have cutoff/fold provenance; training remains blocked when evidence is missing.

tasks.title: Specify the first learned-Core experiment and acceptance rule
tasks.acceptance: Frozen inputs, metric, rejection rule and baseline; neural training is not assumed complete.

tasks.title: Validate status freshness and interrupted-run recovery
tasks.acceptance: Actual revision and checkpoint evidence; local/cloud availability not invented.

tasks.title: Reconcile revenue assumptions with observed research evidence
tasks.acceptance: Revise scenario inputs only from evidence; show unresolved capital/withdrawal decisions.

tasks.title: Freeze the research-alpha candidate and acceptance package
tasks.acceptance: Versioned data/code/config, exact open blockers and explicit limited alpha scope.

tasks.title: Execute the alpha acceptance run in a clean environment
tasks.acceptance: Actual run log and reproducible artifacts; blocked tests are NOT_RUN, not PASS.

tasks.title: Fix alpha acceptance failures or document a release blocker
tasks.acceptance: Scoped regression and refreshed checks; do not force a release to meet the calendar.

tasks.title: Publish the alpha verdict and the next 30-day backlog
tasks.acceptance: PASS/FAIL/INCONCLUSIVE, remaining fifteen-family/Brain work and dated next deliverables.

tasks.title: Resolve the permitted price-data path and sample conditions
tasks.acceptance: Source-specific access/rights matrix and allowed bounded sample, or evidenced access blocker.

tasks.title: Reconcile the fifteen family definitions and write initial cards
tasks.acceptance: Canonical S01-S15 mapping, exact rules, sources, data needs and overlap distinctions.

tasks.title: Record the income target and revenue assumptions
tasks.acceptance: Primary own-capital route; capital, income target and drawdown UNSET until supplied; sensitivity not forecast.

tasks.title: Register temporal competition and search-budget rules
tasks.acceptance: Within-family and cross-family selection occur inside valid folds; all trials counted.

tasks.title: Check macro and news point-in-time source eligibility
tasks.acceptance: Forecast observation, first actual/revisions and timestamp precision; inaccessible history marked ineligible.

tasks.title: Complete strategy cards without presuming performance
tasks.acceptance: Rules and bounded variants for all family IDs; unanswered source questions stay visible.

tasks.title: Evaluate optional analytics revenue without changing the core goal
tasks.acceptance: Candidate customer/problem/price hypotheses; no asserted customers, payments or outside outreach.

tasks.title: Translate verified evidence into a revenue-readiness checklist
tasks.acceptance: Separate trading P&L, withdrawals, subscription revenue and profit; first-income date remains conditional.

tasks.title: Audit alpha claims and list remaining final-test prerequisites
tasks.acceptance: Independent evidence levels, untouched holdout status and no synthetic-performance marketing.
